newsitem.title: UK: Sterling drifts from high, hovers below 3.03 mark.
newsitem.headline: Sterling drifts from high, hovers below 3.03 mark.

text.p: 1135 GMT - Sterling off highs in Europe, hovering below 3.03 marks and $1.64, as dollar slips from peaks.
* Sterling/mark at 3.0240/50, below 3.0310 session highs and 3.0130/40 in late Europe. Cable at $1.6372/82 vs highs of $1.6409 and $1.6404/14 in late Europe.
* Sterling earlier dipped on PMI report. PMI index slipped slightly to 53.4 in July vs 53.5 in June, but reading showed manufacturing expanded for the 14th consecutive month.
* But analysts and traders said the survey highlights concerns about the strength of domestic demand, and reinforces rate rise expectations.
